description: Electron desktop framework layer: sandboxed renderer + contextBridge preload, native dialogs, OS notifications, deep-link routing (macOS open-url + Windows single-instance argv), custom app:// protocol, platform-specific menu builder, and electron-updater auto-update over GitHub Releases. Built with electron-vite + React + TypeScript.

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry Native Desktop
defaults.subheadline: An Electron shell wired deep into the host OS — dialogs, protocols, deep links, notifications, and auto-update.

buildHints.whenToUse: Electron app that needs deep OS integration: native file dialogs, OS notifications, custom protocol (deep links), platform-specific menus, and GitHub Releases auto-update. Use this instead of a plain web framework when the app must run as a signed, distributable desktop binary.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev` — electron-vite starts the Vite dev server and launches Electron; hot-reload is active for the renderer.

The preload bridge (`src/preload/index.ts`) is the ONLY surface area between main and renderer. Add new IPC channels there: expose via `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld` and handle with `ipcMain.handle` in `src/main/index.ts`.

To add a native feature (e.g. tray icon, system-wide hotkey), add the IPC handler in `src/main/index.ts`, expose the call in `src/preload/index.ts`, and call `window.native.<method>()` from the renderer.
Deep links are handled in `src/main/deeplinks.ts`. Register the scheme in `electron-builder.json` under `protocols` (already wired) and listen via `deepLinkState.onUrl()` in `src/main/index.ts`.

Auto-update reads `electron-builder.json`'s `publish` block (GitHub Releases). Set `GH_TOKEN` and run `pnpm package` to build a distributable; subsequent runs will check the configured repo for updates.
Run `pnpm typecheck` before committing — catches main/preload/renderer type errors in one pass.
gotchas: The single-instance lock in `src/main/index.ts` MUST be acquired before `app.whenReady()`. Moving it after breaks Windows deep-link routing (second instance launches instead of routing the URL).
Protocol schemes must be registered via `registerPrivilegedSchemes()` BEFORE `app.whenReady()` — Electron throws if you call `protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged` after the ready event.

The preload is loaded as `src/preload/index.cjs` (electron-vite compiles it to CJS). Do not change the extension or the `sandbox: true` + `contextIsolation: true` flags — removing them wipes the security boundary.

electron-updater silently fails on unsigned/unnotarized binaries in dev. The `checkForUpdates().catch(...)` in `updater.ts` swallows the error intentionally — add a log statement there to debug update issues.
For macOS notarization, set `APPLE_ID`, `APPLE_ID_PASSWORD`, and `APPLE_TEAM_ID` environment variables before running `pnpm package`.

placeholders.description: Demo UI that smoke-tests each native capability card. Replace with your app UI; keep `window.native` calls as-is or extend the preload API for new features.
Replace `{{packageName}}` / `{{projectName}}` with your actual app identifiers. Update the `publish.owner` and `publish.repo` fields to point at your GitHub repo for auto-update.
